message.content: { "drugs": [ { "generic": "azithromycin", "plain_purpose": "an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections such as bronchitis, sinusitis, and skin infections", "common_side_effects": ["diarrhea", "nausea", "abdominal pain", "vomiting"], "key_warning": "can cause serious allergic reactions, liver damage, and heart rhythm changes; stop and seek help if these occur" }, { "generic": "acetaminophen", "plain_purpose": "a pain reliever and fever reducer for minor aches, pains, and fever", "common_side_effects": [], "key_warning": "taking more than 4,000 mg in 24 hours or with alcohol can cause severe liver damage" }, { "generic": "metformin", "plain_purpose": "a diabetes medicine that helps control blood sugar along with diet and exercise", "common_side_effects": ["diarrhea", "nausea or vomiting", "gas", "stomach discomfort"], "key_warning": "rare but serious lactic acidosis can occur; get medical help for unusual tiredness, trouble breathing, or stomach pain" }, { "generic": "atorvastatin", "plain_purpose": "a cholesterol-lowering medicine that helps reduce the risk of heart attack and stroke", "common_side_effects": ["cold-like symptoms", "joint pain", "diarrhea", "muscle pain"], "key_warning": "can cause serious muscle problems (myopathy or rhabdomyolysis); tell your doctor about unexplained muscle pain or weakness" }, { "generic": "aspirin", "plain_purpose": "a pain reliever for minor aches and pains; also used in low dose for heart protection", "common_side_effects": [], "key_warning": "children and teens with flu or chickenpox should not take aspirin due to risk of Reye's syndrome; can cause stomach bleeding" } ] }
